description.en: Waits until every object in an array has finished loading, one after the other (WaitLoading on each element).

examples.case: Waiting for a whole team of models (real usage, from ev42130400.nut)
examples.code: WaitLoadingArray([hTenmaL, hShinsukeL, hShindoL, hTsurugiL, hKuramaL, hHayamiL, hKirinoL, hBuka_AL, hBuka_BL, hBuka_CL]);
